description.from:
```gherkin
Feature: The account's stacks are deployed from Git

  Scenario: A merge to main applies the changed stacks
    Given a stack template under infra/stacks changed in a commit merged to main
    When the Deploy workflow runs
    Then it signs in to AWS with GitHub OIDC as the deploy role, with no stored keys
    And it creates a change set for each changed stack, in the order listed in infra/stacks.json
    And it executes a change set only if it replaces or removes nothing that is not listed as allowed
    And the job summary shows each stack's result

  Scenario: Only main can deploy
    Given a workflow run for a pull request or a branch other than main
    When it asks AWS for the deploy role
    Then AWS refuses

  Scenario: A board-only commit deploys nothing
    Given a commit that changes only project/
    When it is merged to main
    Then the Deploy workflow does not run

  Scenario: Nothing is created by hand
    Given any stack in infra/stacks.json
    Then it is created and changed only by the Deploy workflow, except the one-time apply recorded in HUM-bootstrap
```
